### A Devoted Heart
Author: Debbie Przybylski
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/prayer/a-devoted-heart.html
Passage: Psalm 5:3
Points:
- Relentless daily busyness often leaves the soul exhausted and disconnected from God.
- David learned dependence and devotion in the mundane obscurity of the shepherd's field.
- God values the hidden posture of the heart far more than public achievement or human applause.
- Lasting spiritual strength comes from seeking the Lord in quiet morning prayer and waiting on Him.

### Pastoral Discouragement
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/newsletters/individual/pastoral-discouragement
Passage: Psalm 5:1-12
Points:
- Ministry leaders and servants often face heavy discouragement from criticism and disappointed hopes.
- David brought his honest groaning and sorrow directly before the Lord in prayer.
- Instead of carrying heavy burdens all day, he released them to God in the morning.
- He waited expectantly for God’s response, resting in divine protection and care.
- Shifting attention from personal hardship to God's love transforms despair into peace.
